items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One of them was responsible for that short stint that I had on the Kenton band... he recommended that I take his place on the Kenton band for that – rest of that tour.

ctx.x: Intermission Riff of Stan Kenton. But we would go to the sessions, me and Penick and the guys.
